'''Ecclesis von der Agar''' was an eccentric and decorated [[Nova Scout]] who was somewhat insane during his later [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was defeated at [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], he spent much of his [[Time/Legends|time]] in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] in the [[Vex Asteroid Belt|Vex Belt]]. There, he offered people to join him as apprentice [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], but due to his weakened mind, he often accused them of theft or led them on wild flights through [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], instead of teaching and paying them.<ref name="Gamer" />
